name: Microsoft Purview
description: Microsoft Purview is Microsoft's portfolio for data governance, data security, information protection, data loss prevention, audit, eDiscovery, insider risk, records management, and compliance.
agentUseSummary: Purview is not one uniform user-delegated API. Data governance planes require a trusted service principal and Purview role assignments, eDiscovery exposes privileged legal-case data, and newer Microsoft Graph policy APIs send content for policy evaluation rather than expose a general read surface. Relay mounts no connection or tools until a specific bounded scenario and customer-tenant service-principal contract are selected.

blocked.label: Connect Microsoft Purview
blocked.description: Relay does not yet provision the customer service principal, Purview roles, licenses, and scenario-specific endpoint binding required by Purview's separate API planes.

blocked.label: Read Purview governance or compliance data
blocked.description: Catalog, lineage, classifications, labels, policies, audit, eDiscovery, investigations, insider risk, records, and compliance data remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Evaluate content or change Microsoft Purview
blocked.description: Content submission, policy evaluation, labels, holds, searches, exports, cases, governance objects, role changes, and every mutation remain unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action can be enabled until one bounded Purview scenario has a reviewed customer-tenant identity, role, licensing, data-minimization, and lifecycle contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No Purview connection or tools are mounted while its separate privileged API planes lack a selected bounded Relay contract.

providerSetup.blocker: Microsoft Purview spans distinct API planes with different trust, role, licensing, and data contracts. Data Map and Unified Catalog automation requires a customer service principal explicitly trusted and assigned Purview collection roles. eDiscovery APIs expose privileged litigation and investigation resources and require dedicated Graph permissions and Purview roles. The newer Graph policy APIs evaluate or ingest application content and explicitly are not extraction or analytics APIs.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep Microsoft Purview unavailable until Relay selects one bounded scenario, documents its tenant identity and role model, defines minimization and retention for sensitive governance or compliance data, implements customer-tenant service-principal onboarding and exact endpoint binding, and validates revocation and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Microsoft documents Purview as a portfolio spanning data governance, data security, and data compliance solutions rather than one uniform product API.
Microsoft documents service-principal authentication and explicit Purview collection-role assignments for Data Map and Unified Catalog API access.
Microsoft documents delegated and app-only eDiscovery access to legal cases, holds, searches, exports, review sets, tags, and analytics with subscription and role requirements.
Microsoft documents Purview Graph policy APIs for sending application content to policy evaluation and states that they do not extract Purview data or analytics.
